_comment: What Spark Welcome offers. Every id is a Flathub app id; nothing here is installed until the user ticks it and clicks Install. 'by' is whose app it is. Optional French: name_fr, blurb_fr.

launchers.name: Steam
launchers.blurb: The biggest PC game store. Runs most Windows games through Proton.

launchers.name: Heroic
launchers.blurb: Your Epic Games, GOG and Amazon Prime Gaming libraries.

launchers.name: Lutris
launchers.blurb: Battle.net, EA app, Ubisoft Connect and other launchers, set up by install scripts.

launchers.name: ProtonUp-Qt
launchers.blurb: Adds newer Proton and Wine builds to Steam, Heroic and Lutris, for games that need them.

apps.name: Discord
apps.blurb: Voice, video and text chat, mostly for gaming.

apps.name: Signal
apps.blurb: Encrypted messages and calls. Links to the Signal app on your phone.

apps.name: Spotify
apps.blurb: Music and podcasts streaming. Needs a Spotify account.

apps.name: OBS Studio
apps.blurb: Record your screen or stream to Twitch and YouTube.

apps.name: Bitwarden
apps.blurb: Password manager. Needs a Bitwarden account.
